title: On Improving the Adoption, Usability, and Retention of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Tools
abstract: arXiv:2611.21621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the Internet connects more of the world, software vulnerabilities create growing security risks. Because software developers are responsible for building and maintaining secure applications, they rely on tools and techniques that help identify vulnerabilities early in development. Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools analyze source code to identify potential security weaknesses before software is deployed. Although SAST can help developers address vulnerabilities proactively, these tools also present usability and adoption challenges. This thesis examines those challenges and explores ways to improve the adoption, usability, and continued use of SAST. First, a literature review of 89 research works related to SAST implementation and continued usage identifies recurring developer concerns, including false positives and other usability barriers that can reduce trust in SAST results. translated_title: 关于提升静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具的采用率、可用性与持续使用的研究
translated_abstract: 随着互联网将世界上越来越多的部分连接起来，软件漏洞带来了日益增长的安全风险。由于软件开发人员负责构建和维护安全的应用程序，他们依赖能够在开发早期帮助识别漏洞的工具和技术。静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具通过分析源代码，在软件部署之前识别潜在的安全弱点。尽管SAST可以帮助开发人员主动应对漏洞，但这些工具也带来了可用性和采用方面的挑战。本论文研究了这些挑战，并探索了改善SAST的采用、可用性和持续使用的方法。首先，对89项与SAST实施和持续使用相关的研究工作进行了文献综述，识别出开发人员反复出现的关注点，包括误报以及其他可能降低对SAST结果信任度的可用性障碍。其次，本论文提出了一个流程……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本论文通过对89项相关研究的文献综述识别出开发人员在使用SAST工具时的主要痛点（如误报等可用性障碍），并提出了提升静态应用安全测试工具的采用率、可用性与持续使用的方法。
en_tdlr: This thesis identifies recurring developer concerns (such as false positives) through a literature review of 89 studies and explores ways to improve the adoption, usability, and retention of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools.
